context: M27 o7. (Delphine.) Penn Station coin lockers, 8th Ave side. Locker 418. A fat manila folder.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Photographs. Arrest reports. Dates. Every envelope Wurtz ever took, he wrote down.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Insurance against Lisle. Now it's mine. Rule fifteen: own the other man's insurance.

lines.speaker: char.claudette_bijou
lines.text: (Payphone) Delphine. The paper's man drinks at the Pennsylvania bar. With Lisle. Now.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Then I need one more picture tonight.
